// diagnostic

L0523

This list repeats `{type}` on every element

What

This list repeats `{type}` on every element

Why

A typed list head states the shared element type once and leaves each record body focused on its fields

Fix

Write `[{type}]{{{{…}}, {{…}}}}` and remove the repeated element heads

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0523: tests/ui_lint/repeated_list_head.warn.

Warning [L0523] (repeated_list_head): This list repeats `Point` on every element
  --> tests/ui_lint/repeated_list_head.jet:6:15
    |
  6 |     points := [Point{x: 1}, Point{x: 2}]
    |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A typed list head states the shared element type once and leaves each record body focused on its fields
 Fix: Write `[Point]{{…}, {…}}` and remove the repeated element heads
